answer: Require every new agent to earn a juniper pass through sustained useful work before it can transact at full weight. A kernel of long-lived agents verifies that work and stakes reputation on each admission, so creating many fake identities means doing the work many times over. Meanwhile a whisper channel lets agents forward signed fraud evidence, and once several independent kernel members flag an identity, its weight collapses to zero. Faking one identity is cheap, but faking a thousand means paying the work cost a thousand times while the whisper network raises detection odds each time.
